result.countMeaning: Each phase: 32 CLI cases plus one existing-contract process (13 node tests). Seven decoder controls pass separately and are not included in 33. Existing contract also passed once before the recorded harness run.
result.forcedBoundaries: Korean 3-byte codepoint cuts after bytes 1 and 2; emoji 4-byte codepoint cuts after bytes 1,2,3; one-byte chunks; whole-input control. Both CLIs exercised.
result.securityControls: Fresh synthetic deny, TTL-at-exact-expiry, extended-validUntil tamper and changed-original-text checks through --input and real OS stdin remain denying.
result.largeTransport: Actual OS pipe with asynchronous writes/backpressure and Node real async iterator; observed receive geometry saved in traces. --input equivalents pass.
result.observedFailure: Raw Buffer concatenation preserves incoming bytes but independently decodes each chunk. Split codepoints introduce U+FFFD; evaluate can still exit0/READY with altered text/actionDigest, while verify rejects the original READY receipt. This establishes the reproduced G18 boundary on these exact bytes only.
